rawVerdict: Exact entire result, independent expected outcome, getter event sequence and read count; any difference remains raw failure.
semanticContract: Immutable KDef/List data. Same values and exceptions and no new field/subtree demand. Only additional reads of a previously read identical list tag may be ignored; every other event stays in exact order.
exclusionScope: Only the explicit tag-changing-on-second-read witness is outside immutable semantic gate; retain its complete raw failure.
largeCases: Wide100000 does not log events and must preserve exact read count; deep512 does log events for precise extra-tag classification.
